title: Release Ops Sync — sprint handoff & hotfix coordination
content:
Meeting: Release Ops Sync (weekly) — sprint handoff + hotfix coordination
Date: 2026-03-11 10:00-10:45 PT
Facilitator: Leila Morgan
Notes taker: Ethan Park
Attendees: Leila, Ethan, Diego, Anika, Priya, Marta (partial)

Agenda:
- Quick status on active release trains (stable/beta/canary)
- Hotfix queue and triage decisions
- Changelog highlights for next public release
- Sprint handoff: what shifts to next cycle / on-call overlap
- Action items & owners, rollback readiness check

Highlights / Decisions:
1) Release trains
   - Stable (v1.14.2): shipped 2026-03-10 midnight UTC; small telemetry spike observed on model-inference-12 pool but autoscaler recovered. No customer-facing incidents.
   - Beta (v1.15-beta): rollout at 25% today in us-west; will monitor latency p95 on seq_len 1024 workloads. If p95 > 2200ms for two consecutive 10m windows, pause and revert to v1.14.2 for canaries only.
   - Canary (v1.16-canary): postponed — still waiting on release-scripts PR merging (see linked PR). Diego to finish verification tests by EOD 2026-03-12.

2) Hotfix triage
   - RE-HOT-789 (embed cache eviction bug): triaged as P1 for Dedicated customers. Hotfix patch PR created and needs SRE sign-off. Priya to coordinate validation on a replica Dedicated pool (test-dedicated-03). Target deploy: 2026-03-12 18:00 PT.
   - RE-HOT-790 (console rollout UI mismatch): low risk, scheduled for next sprint (non-hotfix). Marta will capture repro steps in ticket and assign to frontend squad.

3) Changelog notes (public-facing highlights for 3/15 release)
   - Fixed: KV cache eviction causing wrong embeddings for long-session streams (RE-HOT-789).
   - Improved: autoscaler policy for mixed GPU pools to reduce cold-start tail latency.
   - Added: per-request quota-metering debug header (internal flag behind feature gate).
   - Known issues: small p95 latency increase on seq_len=4096 in a specific quantized path — engineering is investigating. Marked under "Known Issues" in release notes.
   - Responsible: Ethan will draft a short public note for docs, Leila will review, Diego will approve infra section.

4) Sprint handoff / on-call overlap
   - Current sprint closes 2026-03-12; retrospective scheduled 2026-03-13. Handoff items moving to next sprint: canary rollout (v1.16), quantization regression investigation, release-scripts CI flakiness.
   - On-call overlap: Priya (SRE) will be primary on-call during hotfix deploy window; Anika will be secondary for rollback orchestration. Slack escalations to go to #release-ops and @oncall-sre.

5) Rollback readiness checklist (confirm by owner before any canary->beta promotion)
   - Monitoring dashboards linked in release playbook (Confluence).
   - Automated rollback job tested on staging in last 7 days? -> yes for stable, no for v1.16-canary (Diego).
   - DB/migration safe state? -> none planned for this release.

Standup log (compact, for handoff) — 2026-03-11:
- Leila: verified stable rollout metrics; open follow-up to confirm telemetry normalization by tomorrow.
- Ethan: drafting changelog, queueing docs PR; will add heatmap for p95 by model-size.
- Diego: finishing release-scripts test; blocked on flaky e2e caused by environment teardown (see GH PR discussion).
- Anika: prepping hotfix test plan for RE-HOT-789; will run canary smoke tests pre-deploy.
- Priya: reserved test-dedicated-03 for validation at 17:00 PT; coordinating with infra to ensure no other jobs overlap.
- Marta: capturing UI repro for RE-HOT-790, will create a demo screencap for frontend.

Open issues / risks:
- Risk: release-scripts CI flakiness could delay canary by 24–48h. Mitigation: allow manual promotion path with documented checklist; Diego to provide steps and two approvers.
- Risk: autoscaler config tweak in beta might interact with Dedicated config. Need to run e2e with Dedicated-like traffic pattern. Decision: schedule a Dedicated-simulation run on 2026-03-13.

Action items (owner — due)
- Diego Ramos — finish release-scripts e2e fixes and merge PR (#212) — due 2026-03-12 EOD.
- Priya Shah — validate hotfix RE-HOT-789 on test-dedicated-03 and sign-off for deploy — due 2026-03-12 16:00 PT.
- Ethan Park — draft public-facing changelog and docs PR for 3/15 release — due 2026-03-12 12:00 PT.
- Marta Kowalski — attach UI repro and assign RE-HOT-790 to frontend owner — due 2026-03-13.
- Leila Morgan — update release playbook with new rollback checklist and escalate manual-promotion flow — due 2026-03-13.

Notes to self / informal: 
- Add a short snippet in playbook about telemetry spike false positives (context: model-inference-12 oscillation after night deploy).
- Verify that the new quota-metering header is behind the feature gate in production config (I think it is but double-check).

Next meeting: 2026-03-18 10:00 PT (weekly cadence) — agenda: post-release review, hotfix closure, canary promotion decision.

Quick references (tickets & links):
- RE-1428: release train schedule + tag mapping (Confluence linked above)
- RE-HOT-789: embed cache eviction bug (PR and test plan linked in ticket)
- PR: release-scripts/pull/212 (blocking canary merge)
- Slack: #release-ops thread t12345-abcde for realtime deploy logs

End of notes.

Draft status: informal working doc — will be polished into release notes and playbook updates after owners check off tasks.
